SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the volcanoes, the hilltop castle or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Around her, as her world makes them: a little enchanted music box; a small glazed porcelain wine cup; lantern-orbs of soft magical light floating overhead.
Season: jacaranda time in March — the city's jacaranda trees in full violet bloom, purple blossoms carpeting the pavements.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Small moment: soap bubbles drift through the air in front of her.
Outfit: a 1920s bias-cut satin lounge gown — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a small jewelled hair clip, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.

SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the right of the frame; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.

PROP: with her own right hand she tugs the brim of a soft felt traveller's cap with a short leather brim on her head down low over her eyes; it is all she holds.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slender silver wand wound with a living flowering vine whose tips glow softly — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
